facts.fact: SARS says its Single Window electronic inspection workflow, sharing inspection cases with the Border Management Authority, was implemented in September 2023 but is still in restricted testing with selected importers, and the full National Single Window is 'still some time away'.
SARS says it has an automated inspection and case management workflow that the Single Window extends to other government agencies.
facts.system: SARS automated inspection and case management workflow

note: Release says over 99% of truck manifests are reported electronically and a Single Window with Transnet is being implemented, but states no declaration system in service and no single window delivered.

facts.fact: SARS says a new customs management system, replacing some 26 legacy and paper-based systems, was fully operational from 18 August 2013 for all commercial cross-border trade.
SARS says it has implemented an interface system with Mozambique's customs and that discussions are under way with Zimbabwe.

note: The VTS reads number plates for vehicle crime; it does not process customs declarations.

facts.fact: SARS told Freight News that the National Single Window is being introduced in phases, with an electronic inspection workflow implemented in September 2023 and selected importers in phased testing, and gave no completion date.
